Police Response The Getevallei police area received reports ⁣of‌ the shooting at approximately 8:55 p.m. ‌They promptly dispatched officers to the​ scene, accompanied by the federal judicial police (PJF) of Louvain and a forensic laboratory. A judicial perimeter was established ‌to secure the area and gather evidence.

Community Reaction The incident has raised concerns among the residents of Hoegaarden. Witnesses described ​the scene as chaotic, with people rushing to ensure their safety and that of their neighbors. The ​community is eagerly awaiting updates from the authorities regarding the progress ⁢of the investigation.

A recent ⁢article titled “People ‌are more afraid”: do the⁤ shots in Brussels harm tourism in our capital? highlights the broader impact⁤ of such incidents on the tourism industry.
